name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted online file converter for images, video, audio, documents, e-books and 3D assets, supporting over a thousand formats.

alerts.message: Anyone who opens the site first can register the first account. Create your account right after deployment; further sign-ups stay disabled unless ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION is set to true.
HTTPS is required: the login cookie is marked secure, so signing in fails on a plain HTTP domain.
